## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle (1卷) **Esoteric lineage-record** in the *xuèmài* 血脈 ("blood-line") genre, compiled and supplemented (*zēngbǔ* 增補) by **Zàoxuán** [造玄](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%80%A0%E7%8E%84), a late-Tang Esoteric ācārya at the **Cíēnsì** 慈恩寺 in the Chángān **Zuǒjiē** 左街. Preserved as **X59 no. 1074** in the *Xùzàngjīng*.

**Abstract**

The *Xuèmài* presents the parallel lineages of the two Esoteric schools:

- **Garbhadhātu (Tāizàngjiè 胎藏界):** beginning with **Dàrì** 大日 (Mahāvairocana) at the source.
- **Vajradhātu (Jīngāngjiè 金剛界):** beginning with the parallel transmission.

The work parallels *Jīntāi liǎngjiè shīzī xiāngchéng* 金胎兩界師資相承 ([KR6j0748](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0748)) by [海雲](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B5%B7%E9%9B%B2) but with the substantial advantage of an explicit transmission-date (865 CE), making it one of the most precisely-datable Tang Esoteric lineage documents. The format — *fùshǔ shīzī xuèmài* "entrusted master-and-disciple blood-line" — is the formal Esoteric ritual document of lineage-transmission: each named master in the chain has officially "entrusted" his lineage to the next, and the document constitutes the institutional record of that transmission.
